> Multivariate logistic regression model analysis showed that participants who were unmarried … had 64% higher odds of having a successful treatment outcome (AOR = 1.64; 95% CI = 1.05–2.47; p = 0.017) compared to those who were married. **【批注句】** The most likely explanation could be due to married individuals in the Gamo zone …

> This finding **appears to differ from that of some previous studies**, which **have reported** that unmarried individuals had **lower levels of social support** [9, 21, 27].

2. **“demonstrated” → “have reported”** — 所引 [9, 21, 27] 均为观察性研究，用 “demonstrated”（证实）拔高了证据强度。
